description: Get one student's submission for an assignment by user_id, returning the Canvas submission object (score, grade, workflow_state, submitted_at, body/url, submission_comments). user_id can be any user in the course, not only the caller's own. Use list_submissions to fetch every student's submission for the assignment in a single call instead of one get_submission call per student, or get_my_submissions when the caller wants their own submissions across a whole course rather than one assignment. Defaults to including submission_comments; pass `include` to add submission_history, rubric_assessment, visibility, course, user, or read_status instead.

include.description: Extra fields to include (Canvas include[] param). Defaults to ["submission_comments"] when omitted.

name: get_submission
title: Get Submission
